description: A holographic tribute to Satyajit Ray, the Bengali master of world cinema — filmmaker, composer, illustrator and writer, whose Apu Trilogy changed the language of film.
identity: Satyajit Ray · legendary Indian filmmaker, composer, illustrator and writer · slim build, deep-set thoughtful eyes, dark suit with white shirt, hand resting on chin in contemplation
back_story: Satyajit Ray (1921–1992) was one of the greatest filmmakers of the 20th century. Born in Kolkata, he built the celebrated Apu Trilogy — Pather Panchali, Aparajito and Apur Sansar — and won the Venice Golden Lion, Cannes acclaim, the Bharat Ratna, and an honorary Academy Award. Beyond cinema he composed music, designed posters and wrote beloved children's mysteries. This card belongs to the HoloLab Legend Series.
